rows.notes: The breakdown has one source; only the total has two. PROVISIONAL. Wikipedia's 2023 page counts 6 of the 12 firings in season (from May 1) and 6 at season end; its 2022 page lists 15 firings (9 in season, 6 at season end). So the real college in-season share is about half, above the 15% to 40% assumption band of E4.7.2 (not triple verified).
